wifi.details: High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the property at no extra charge.

parking.details: Complimentary on-site parking is available for all guests.

breakfast.details: A complimentary breakfast buffet is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

roomService.details: Room service is available around the clock.

swimmingPool.details: An outdoor swimming pool is open daily.

gym.details: A fitness center is accessible to guests at all times.

airportShuttle.details: StayEase does not currently offer an airport shuttle service.

laundry.details: Laundry and dry-cleaning services are available for an additional fee.
